content.body: The German Rifle Grenadier employed a regular infantry rifle and a cup-launched fragmentation grenade. It was an anti-personnel weapon and not an anti-armor weapon.
content.brief: WEAPON: Mauser Karabiner 98k AMMO: 7.92 mm Gewehr Patrone 98 sS MAGAZINE: 5 round clip MUZZLE VELOCITY: 745 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-shot bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Grenade Firing Cup GewSprGr 30 HE Grenades (10) Combat Knife
content.title: Grenadier
